articles.title: 'I'm fed up of swiping': Why singles now want to meet IRL
articles.summary: The BBC hears from people who think dating events are better value for money than dating apps.

articles.title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
articles.summary: AI labs have staked their reputations on model benchmarking — the supposedly neutral and accurate system of evaluations that are designed to measure whether one AI product is better than another. However, the methods behind these evaluations are complicated and still maturing, said Irene Solaiman, Hugging Face’s chief policy officer, during a discussion at TechCrunch…
